crossRefs.note: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the…
that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

translations.web: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.
translations.bsb: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.
translations.kjv: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
translations.asv: Whether then it be I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
